headlines.title: 国家统计局：上半年原材料制造业利润快速增长
headlines.summary: 上半年，规模以上原材料制造业利润同比增长71.7%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长8.8个百分点。从行业看，在铜、铝等有色金属产品需求向好等因素推动下，有色行业利润增长99.4%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长4.7个百分点；在石油产业链条相关产品价格上涨推动下，石油加工行业同比扭亏为盈，化工行业利润增长67.8%。

headlines.title_en: NBS: Raw material manufacturing profits grew rapidly in H1.
headlines.summary_en: In H1, profits of above-scale raw materials manufacturing rose 71.7% YoY, contributing 8.8 percentage points to all above-scale industrial firms' profit growth. By sector, non-ferrous metals profits surged 99.4% (driven by copper, aluminum demand), boosting overall growth by 4.7 percentage points; oil processing turned profitable YoY, and chemicals profits rose 67.8% amid higher oil-chain prices.

headlines.title: Price of parenting: the household maths giving China’s consumers pause
headlines.summary:
Qiu Huiying, a human resources manager in Guangdong, worries in numerical terms when she looks ahead to the next decade: a 20-year mortgage, a 10 per cent loss on her property and thousands of yuan in monthly childcare costs that are set to rise.
She bought a 624 sq ft flat last year, so her mother-in-law could move in and help care for her son. But the purchase now feels less prudent after prices in the 20-year-old complex have already fallen by about 10 per cent.

headlines.title: 国家统计局：上半年人工智能与各领域加速融合，算力需求大幅增长，推动电子行业利润同比增长96.9%
headlines.summary: 电子相关行业利润高速增长。上半年，人工智能与各领域加速融合，算力需求大幅增长，推动电子行业利润同比增长96.9%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长8.5个百分点，是规模以上工业企业利润较快增长的重要支撑。其中，服务器、高性能工作站相关领域中，计算机整机制造、计算机外围设备制造行业利润分别增长689.3%、305.8%；电子器件制造领域中，集成电路制造、半导体分立器件制造行业利润增长2579.5%、31.2%；电子元件及电子专用材料制造领域中，电子专用材料制造、电子电路制造行业利润增长209.7%、26.9%。

headlines.title_en: NBS: AI integration with various sectors accelerated in H1, surging computing power demand drove the electronics industry's profits up 96.9% year-on-year.
headlines.summary_en: Electronics profits grew rapidly. In H1, AI integration across fields boosted computing demand, lifting electronics profits by 96.9% YoY, contributing 8.5 percentage points to above-scale industrial firms' profit growth—a key driver. By segment: server/high-end workstation areas: computer whole-machine manufacturing profits up 689.3%, peripherals up 305.8%; electronic device manufacturing: integrated circuits up 2579.5%, discrete semiconductor devices up 31.2%; electronic components and materials: electronic specialty materials up 209.7%, circuit manufacturing up 26.9%.

headlines.title: 中国即将发行或正在发行的国债和政策性金融债
headlines.summary: 上半年，规模以上原材料制造业利润同比增长71.7%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长8.8个百分点。从行业看，在铜、铝等有色金属产品需求向好等因素推动下，有色行业利润增长99.4%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长4.7个百分点；在石油产业链条相关产品价格上涨推动下，石油加工行业同比扭亏为盈，化工行业利润增长67.8%。

headlines.title: 经济学家：尽管油价飙升，英国央行料维持利率不变
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月27日讯，经济学家预测，在中东冲突再度爆发、能源价格再次飙升的背景下，英国央行将在本周会议上“强硬表态”，但会维持利率不变。自货币政策委员会6月上次会议以来，美伊停火协议的破裂已将全球油价推回每桶100美元附近，欧洲天然气价格也飙升至冲突初期以来的最高水平。如果海湾地区的航运路线继续受阻，油价可能进一步上涨。英国经济在冲突爆发初期表现好于货币政策委员会的预期，截至5月份的三个月内，GDP增长了0.7%。目前几乎没有迹象表明能源冲击会引发更持久的价格压力。CPI已连续三个月低于预期，6月份降至2.6%。作为通胀压力主要来源之一的工资增长已经放缓

headlines.title_en: Economists: BOE expected to hold rates steady despite oil price surge.
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data July 27: Economists predict the Bank of England will 'sound hawkish' at this week's meeting but keep rates unchanged amid renewed Middle East conflict and surging energy prices. Since the MPC's June meeting, the US-Iran ceasefire breakdown has pushed global oil near $100/barrel; European gas prices hit highest since conflict's early days. Oil may rise further if Gulf shipping routes remain disrupted. UK economy performed better than MPC expected, with GDP up 0.7% in the three months to May. Little sign yet of persistent price pressure from energy shock; CPI has been below expectations for three consecutive months, falling to 2.6% in June. Wage growth, a key inflation source, has slowed.
